resources.string: Return to WebPOS in Chrome and tap Refresh printers in Settings.
Tap Set default on the printer you want WebPOS to use. Use Test on any row to verify that printer.
Printer connection closed too early. Try Test on the specific printer row, or re-pair Bluetooth.
Bluetooth permission required. Allow Nearby devices for Reborn Print Bridge in Android Settings, then try again.
No printers found yet. Connect USB or pair Bluetooth, or add a LAN IP.
Runs Print Bridge in the background after every restart and reconnects USB, Bluetooth, and Wi‑Fi printers.
Print Bridge will start automatically after reboot
Print Bridge will not start after reboot until you open this app
Your %1$s device may stop Print Bridge unless battery and autostart are configured.
Could not open that settings screen. Open App info manually in Android Settings.
Android may stop background apps to save battery. These quick steps make sure Print Bridge keeps running and reconnects to your USB, Bluetooth, and Wi‑Fi printers after every reboot.
Allow Reborn Print Bridge to run without battery limits. Tap the button below and choose Allow or Unrestricted when prompted.
Battery restriction is already disabled for Print Bridge.
Battery restriction is still active. Tap Allow unrestricted battery, then return here.
On Sunmi devices, open Autostart management and enable Reborn Print Bridge so it starts automatically after reboot.
On Feitian devices, open App info for Reborn Print Bridge, then set Battery to Unrestricted and allow background activity if shown.
Open your device\'s autostart or startup manager and enable Reborn Print Bridge. This prevents the system from blocking Print Bridge after reboot.
Open recent apps, find Reborn Print Bridge, then tap the lock icon (or pull down) so Android does not close it when clearing other apps.
Print Bridge is configured to run in the background. After reboot it will start automatically and reconnect to your printers. You can reopen this wizard anytime from the main screen.
